programs.title: May the Best Wedding Win
programs.desc: When Tiffany's fiancé calls off their wedding, she's heartbroken that her dream wedding is cancelled. Tiffany convinces unsuccessful actor Nicholas to pretend to be her fiancé in exchange for signing him to her agency, and the dream wedding happens for someone.

programs.title: A Bestselling Kind of Love
programs.desc: Nora is thrilled when her first novel soars to the top of the bestsellers list but is terrified of speaking in front of crowds to promote it. Her agent hires Daniel, a public speaking coach, to help her overcome her fears.

programs.title: Hashtag Proposal
programs.desc: A fake marriage proposal goes viral, and all the attention helps two strangers with their struggling businesses. Millie and Leo play pretend while trying to ignore their growing feelings.

programs.title: A Match for the Prince
programs.desc: A medieval romance novelist is hired to be a matchmaker for a real-life prince in a desperate attempt to find true love before the fixed royal wedding date.

programs.title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
programs.desc: After Cheryl's three-year engagement ends in a devastating breakup, her life is turned upside down when her aunt offers her an escape from Chicago to the Amish town of Sugarcreek. Struggling with being a fish out of water, Cheryl uncovers an unsettling secret that could disrupt the small town of Ohio. As Cheryl begins to solve the mystery, she finds community, belonging and the potential of new love.

programs.title: When Hope Calls: Brookfield
programs.desc: The robbery investigation intensifies as Reynolds questions Justine about her stolen ring, while tension grows between Wyatt and Hannah as her career pulls her in a new direction. Across Brookfield, Wally grieves his father, Sam struggles with change, and relationships are tested through moments of vulnerability and emotional growth.
